landing.interviewQuestion: “Explain how React's reconciliation algorithm works. How would you optimize a component that re-renders unnecessarily? Give a concrete example.”
landing.interviewUserAnswer: React uses a diffing algorithm that compares the virtual DOM tree with the previous one. It reconciles by comparing element types — if the type changes, it unmounts and remounts; otherwise it updates props recursively. I'd use React.memo on pure components and useCallback/useMemo for functions and values passed as props...
landing.interviewStrength1: Correctly explained reconciliation and key-based updates
landing.interviewImprove1: Did not mention `key` prop impact on reconciliation
landing.interviewImprove2: No concrete example of profiling with React DevTools
